pages.title: Arrows: Relax Game
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Find a way to slide every arrow off the board in Arrows: Relax Game. Check which direction an arrow points and whether another piece blocks its path. Clear the arrows in an order that opens up the rest of the layout. You can take as long as you need to think through a move.

pages.title: Falafel Master
pages.creator: YashbSolutions
pages.description: Keep up with the lunch queue in Falafel Master. Prepare falafel, bread, tea, and other items as orders come in, then serve each customer before their patience runs out. Use the coins you earn to improve the restaurant and see how well you can handle the next day's orders.

pages.title: Hexa Honey Sort
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Place colored stacks on a honeycomb board in Hexa Honey Sort. Bring matching top tiles together to collect groups of ten or more. One placement can set off several matches, so check the stacks around an open cell before using it. Work through the collection goals across 90 levels.

pages.title: Draw One Part Brain Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Look for what's missing from each picture in Draw One Part Brain Puzzle. Work out which detail would make the scene complete, then draw that part in the empty space. Every level gives you a new illustration to figure out, from spotting the gap to sketching the answer.

pages.title: Delivery Now
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Choose your own route through city traffic in Delivery Now. Get the delivery to its destination before time runs out, looking for a way around traffic when the direct route gets crowded. The open world gives you room to change course as you work through more deliveries.

pages.title: Happy Monsters 2
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Play short games with the little monsters in Happy Monsters 2. Tap the notes as colored balls fall in Color Rhythm, or fly a toy plane and dodge enemy fire. Earn coins in the games and use them to unlock toys for the collection.

pages.title: Panda Mahjong Classic
pages.creator: Sanoma
pages.description: Take on the panda's five tests in Panda Mahjong Classic. Match tiles with no tile on top and at least one long side open. Look for pairs that free up more of the layout, and remember that flowers and seasons can match within their own groups even when the pictures differ.

pages.title: Phantom thief Cat Running
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Tap to change the cat's direction in Phantom thief Cat Running. Dodge obstacles and pick up items that restore stamina or add to your score. Three stars make the cat temporarily invincible. Fish bones drain stamina, but collecting ten of them briefly turns coins into more valuable diamonds.

pages.title: Guinea Piggy Matching
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Move tiles into the holding area in Guinea Piggy Matching. Three of a kind disappear and free up slots for the next tiles. Clear the layout to earn a golden puzzle piece, then use those pieces to uncover pictures of guinea pigs.

pages.title: Head Soccer Arena
pages.creator: Goolandia
pages.description: Play a quick football match or work through 15 career leagues in Head Soccer Arena. You can also face a second player on the same device. Win matches to earn coins and diamonds, then improve power-ups such as ice, lightning, and the anvil as you unlock more characters.

pages.title: U Shape Puzzle
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Clear the board in U Shape Puzzle by tapping blocks to slide them out. Look at which paths are blocked and remove pieces in an order that frees the others. Work through tougher arrangements as you advance, or try a daily challenge when you want a fresh layout.

pages.title: Ninja Spell Match
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Link at least three tiles in Ninja Spell Match to attack, defend, or recover. Decide which action you need as each group of enemies appears, then make the match that gives it to you. Clear every wave to advance through 30 stages with traps and rival ninjas.

pages.title: Cubatoria Merge 2048
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Bring together blocks with the same color and value in Cubatoria Merge 2048. Combine them into higher numbers in the 3D play area. Toss blocks into the river to trade them for coins, then spend the coins to improve your merge power and build up bigger values.

pages.title: Meow Market
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Help a white tabby stock its vegetable shop in Meow Market. Select groups of matching vegetables to harvest them in one move. Harvesting uses a move, and your supply of moves recovers over time. Look for a group worth picking before spending one on the board.

pages.title: Dinosaur Cards
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Find matching dinosaur cards in Dinosaur Cards. Look at the creatures on the cards and make sets before the timer expires. Keep track of the dinosaurs you still need as you go, then complete the remaining matches to finish the challenge.

pages.title: Sort Parking
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Move cars between parking areas until each type is grouped together in Sort Parking. A full lot can't take another car, and a car can't go in front of a different type. Earn coins for more car models and collect pieces as you clear stages to change the background.

pages.title: BFFs Black Friday Shopping
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Dress Brian and four friends for a trip to the mall in BFFs Black Friday Shopping. Choose a different outfit for each shopper, then put the finishing touches on their looks with purses and jewelry. Get the whole group ready for the Black Friday outing.

pages.title: Fashion Stylist
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Match tiles to help clients get the makeovers they want in Fashion Stylist. Pick clothes, hairstyles, and makeup according to the look each person is after. One client might need a new wardrobe for work, while another wants a more elegant style or a chance to try something different.

pages.title: OMG Word Professor
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trace words from the available letters in OMG Word Professor. Tap and drag through the letters in order to make a word. When a word leaves you stuck, work toward a better score to unlock hints and get help with the puzzle.

pages.title: Stickman Gradient
pages.description: Guide a running stick figure through city streets in Stickman Gradient. Watch the path ahead and move out of the way as obstacles approach. Keep your runner going by looking for a clear lane before the next obstacle reaches you.

pages.title: Mahjong Relax
pages.creator: CHORSE GAMES LIMITED
pages.description: Clear a board of summer-themed tiles in Mahjong Relax. Look for matching pairs and check what their removal makes available. Choose from three difficulty settings and play different layouts to unlock more tiles and backgrounds for your next game.

pages.title: Sweet Boom - Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Pop the sweets on a checkerboard in Sweet Boom - Puzzle Game. You only get a limited number of taps on each level, so look at the arrangement before you pick a target. Work out which sweets to pop to clear the board with the moves available.

pages.title: Nail Stack!
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect white nails along a 3D course in Nail Stack! Each one adds length to the nail you're building. Guide it through colored brushes and decoration stations to change its appearance, then see what it looks like when you reach the end of the run.

pages.title: Hug and Kis City
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Get both characters safely to the door in Hug and Kis City. Collect gold along the way, watch for zombies, and find the key that opens the exit. Reaching it with just one character leaves the job unfinished, so plan a route for both of them.

pages.title: Battery Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Collect batteries along a 3D course in Battery Run. Avoid spinning gears that can end the run, and watch for electric toys that can drain the batteries you've picked up. Try to bring as much charge as possible to the wall at the end of each level.

pages.title: Poppy Survive Time: Hugie Wugie
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Search an abandoned toy factory for the Poppy Doll in Poppy Survive Time: Hugie Wugie. Find the items needed to open its box within five days, and keep quiet so Huggy Wuggy has a harder time finding you. Choose shooter mode if you'd like to fight him directly.

pages.title: Purple Monster Adventure
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Guide a purple monster through the valley in Purple Monster Adventure. Jump past obstacles and watch out for mushroom enemies as you look for a route to the end. Collect stars along the way to add to your score before you finish each level.

pages.title: K Challenge 456
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Take on five challenges to escape an island in K Challenge 456. Stop on cue, cross a glass bridge, play marbles, pull in tug of war, and tackle Ppopgi. Each event gives you a different task on the way to the 456 million prize.

pages.title: Candy Maker Factory
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Tour a candy factory and try the equipment in Candy Maker Factory. Follow the steps to make treats such as gummy candy, rock candy, and chocolate bars. Work with the tools and machines at each station to see how the different sweets come together.

pages.title: Fast Balls
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fire colored balls from a cannon to knock down towers in Fast Balls. Hold to keep firing and let go when a moving obstacle cuts across your line of fire. Clear every tower to advance, then look for the next opening as the layout changes.

pages.title: Imposter Dash
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Jump over traps as the imposter runs from astronauts in Imposter Dash. Keep watching the ground ahead so you can take off before reaching a hazard. The run keeps moving, making the timing of each jump important if you want to stay ahead.

pages.title: Gold Coin Machine Master
pages.creator: Saddam
pages.description: Try coin claw machines and giant prize wheels in Gold Coin Machine Master. Pick a machine, work on collecting gold coins, and see what prizes you can pick up along the way. Switch between the arcade games as you try to improve your high score.

pages.title: Mr Meat House Of Flesh
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search a slaughterer's house for a woman being held prisoner in Mr Meat House Of Flesh. The slaughterer has become an undead threat, so work your way through the house with an eye out for danger. Find the captive and get her out alive.

pages.title: Monster Truck Stunts Free Jeep Racing Games
pages.creator: WebAvari
pages.description: Take a monster truck onto a 3D stunt course in Monster Truck Stunts. Try to keep control as you perform tricks, hit obstacles, and crash through parts of the environment. Choose a truck and see how it handles as you take on the next stunt.

pages.title: Rotation Blast
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Wait for the rotating ball to line up with the target in Rotation Blast, then tap or click to take the shot. Each hit keeps the run going and gives you a new target to aim for. See how many hits you can put together.

pages.title: Pawn Boss
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Run a pawn shop and bargain with customers in Pawn Boss. Look over each item before you agree to a price and try to bring the seller's asking price down. Some of the items are fakes, so check what you're buying before you hand over your money.

pages.title: Cook Up! Yummy Kitchen Cooking
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Pick a recipe from the cookbook in Cook Up! Yummy Kitchen Cooking. Work through its preparation steps in the kitchen to turn the ingredients into a finished dish. Try another recipe once you've completed the first and see how the tasks change from meal to meal.

pages.title: Cute Teddy Bears Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build a picture of a teddy bear in Cute Teddy Bears Puzzle. Pick one of six images, then decide how many pieces you want to work with. Start with 16 pieces or try a 36-, 64-, or 100-piece version for a more detailed jigsaw.

pages.title: Pick Up Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Choose a pickup truck drawing in Pick Up Trucks Coloring and give it a palette of your own. Use the mouse to color the picture and the eraser to fix a mistake or change a choice. Try another truck when you want a different shape to work on.

pages.title: Easy Kids Coloring Game
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fill large outlined pictures with color in Easy Kids Coloring Game. Pick a drawing and choose colors for its different sections. The drawings use thick outlines and simple shapes, making the spaces easy to see while you work through the picture.

pages.title: Numbers Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Decide which side has the greater value in Numbers Challenge, or choose the equal option if the two values match. Get five answers right in a row to move up a level. The calculations get more involved as you advance, and you can check your accuracy in the stats.

pages.title: Frankenstein Adventures
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Jump from wall to wall in Frankenstein Adventures to work your way toward the treasure chest. Tap to jump while the monster runs, and watch for blades and spikes as you climb. Pick up stars along the route before you reach the chest and move on.

pages.title: Kids Cards Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Turn over cards to reveal children's faces in Kids Cards Match. Remember where you've seen each face and use that information to find pairs. If the pictures differ, keep both positions in mind for later. Clear every card to finish the level.

pages.title: Eatable Numbers
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Move the red piece toward blue pieces with smaller numbers in Eatable Numbers. Each safe hit adds points, but a piece with a larger number is one to avoid. Read the numbers quickly as the pieces move faster and it gets harder to steer toward the right target.

pages.title: Couple Goals Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Pick one of twelve pictures of couples in Couple Goals Jigsaw. Rebuild it from 25 pieces for a smaller puzzle, or choose 49 or 100 pieces when you want more details to sort through. Use matching edges and parts of the picture to work out where the pieces fit.

pages.title: Battle Royale Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Start with the first picture in Battle Royale Jigsaw and solve it to unlock the next one. The collection has twelve puzzles. Choose 25, 49, or 100 pieces for each image, then work out where the pieces belong from their shapes and details.

pages.title: Cheerleader Magazine Dress
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Put together looks for a squad in Cheerleader Magazine Dress. Try different outfits on the cheerleaders and decide which combinations suit the sporty theme. Give each cheerleader her own style, then look over the lineup you've put together.

pages.title: Paint Blue
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Guide a ball through the corridors in Paint Blue. Use the arrow keys to leave a painted trail as it moves. Look for any turns or stretches you've missed and cover the whole maze before moving on to a harder layout.

pages.title: Tag the Flag
pages.creator: Derek John Evers
pages.description: Play as the Blue Soldier and search enemy territory for the red flag in Tag the Flag. Shoot to fend off the Red Soldiers or raise your shield when you need to defend. Use the space in the arena to reach their flag before they get to yours.

pages.title: Police Cars Parking
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Guide a police car into the marked space in Police Cars Parking. Get past cones and barriers at first, then work through larger areas where cars, ambulances, and other obstacles can block your route. Give yourself room to turn before lining up with the parking spot.

pages.title: Army Commando
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Enter a hostile group's headquarters in Army Commando. Fight from a first-person view and work through the objectives as you encounter armed opponents. Look for the enemies along your route and take them out as you advance through the base.

pages.title: Brian Adventures On The Beach
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Help Brian collect three shells in Brian Adventures On The Beach. Guide him with the mouse or arrow keys as you search the beach, and look for food to feed him along the way. Keep going until you've found all the shells he needs.

pages.title: Rope Hero
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Climb walls and jump between rooftops in Rope Hero. Move through the city to track down the gang threatening its residents. Use the rooftops to get around, then bring out your weapons when you need to confront the enemies below.

pages.title: Agent Shooting
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Take on assignments against a criminal force in Agent Shooting. Choose from weapons such as pistols, shotguns, sniper rifles, and rocket launchers. The game also includes vehicles such as tanks and aircraft, giving you more ways to approach the fighting.

pages.title: Summer Vacation Dressup
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Plan what to wear for the flight and the first day of a family holiday in Summer Vacation Dressup. Try several combinations from the summer wardrobe and see how the pieces look together. Choose your favorite once you've put together a few outfits for the trip.

pages.title: Traffic Racer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Thread your car through traffic in Traffic Racer. Steer with A and D or the left and right arrows, then press W or Up Arrow for a burst of speed when the road opens up. Try a different driving mode or take a run on the desert or snowy roads.

pages.title: Water Slides.io
pages.creator: Super Apps
pages.description: Start at the back of the field and work your way into first in Water Slides.io. Steer around other racers or block them when they try to pass. Hit speed boosters and use ramps to jump, then look for another opening as you race down the slide.

pages.title: Cake Shop
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take customer orders and make cakes to match in Cake Shop. Check the requested shape before you bake the base, then add the filling and decorations. Serve the finished cake and get ready for another customer as you work through the shop's levels.

pages.title: Cricket World Cup
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Pick a national team and take your turn at bat in Cricket World Cup. Tap to swing as the ball comes in and adjust your timing with each delivery. Try to hit a six as you face the opposing side and build up your team's score.

pages.title: Airplanes Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Pick one of six aircraft pictures in Airplanes Puzzle. Put it together from 16 pieces, or choose a 36-, 64-, or 100-piece layout to make the same image more challenging. Use details such as the wings and fuselage to work out where the pieces belong.

pages.title: Hamster Roll
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drop a hungry hamster into a board full of pegs in Hamster Roll. Choose where to release it, then watch it bounce down through the board and pick up seeds and pins. Try to land on the sunflower at the bottom to earn a bonus.

pages.title: Challenge Of The Zombies
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Take out every zombie before you run out of ammunition in Challenge Of The Zombies. Use the mouse to line up each shot and check where the zombies are standing before you fire. The number of bullets is limited, so make each shot count.

pages.title: Monster Heart Surgery
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Draculaura replace Frankie's heart in Monster Heart Surgery. Follow the procedure as the two friends play doctor, then put away the medical tools and move on to dress-up. Choose an outfit for each of them once the operation is over.

pages.title: EG Koala
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Guide a sleeping koala past moving hazards in EG Koala. Collect stars to build your score and stay away from anything that might wake the koala. The obstacles move faster as you go, so look for a safe path to each star before you move.

pages.title: Captain Snowball
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Take cover and throw snowballs at other players in Captain Snowball. Use structures to hide until you have an opening to throw. Look for health kits and double-damage power-ups, then see how your score compares with other players on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Halloween Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Compare two Halloween scenes in Halloween Differences and pick out the seven changes in each pair. You have a minute per level, so scan the pictures for missing or altered details. Work through all ten scenes if you can spot every change in time.

pages.title: Minesweeper Deluxe
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Use number clues to uncover safe squares in Minesweeper Deluxe. Each number tells you how many neighboring squares contain mines. Work out which squares you can open and which you should flag, then keep uncovering the board without setting off a mine.

pages.title: Words Search
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Find the words from the list beneath the grid in Words Search. Scan the letters for the first part of a word, then follow the sequence to see if it matches. Keep going until you've found the whole list and try to finish in less time.

pages.title: Ladybug Masquerade Maqueover
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Marinette recover from a fight and get ready for a masquerade in Ladybug Masquerade Maqueover. Treat her wounds and bruises first. Once she's ready for the makeover, choose makeup and an outfit that fit the royal masquerade.

pages.title: Coloring Underwater World
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Color fish and a giant octopus in Coloring Underwater World. Free mode lets you pick your own colors. In Challenge mode, study the reference and try to recreate it for five stars. If you forget a color, you can check the hint again after a minute.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Adam find Eve again in Adam and Eve 3. Click or tap objects and characters in each scene to see what they do. Work out which actions clear the way for Adam, then send him through and look for a way past the next obstacle.

pages.title: Fashion Magazine 2017
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Get fashion models ready for their big event in Fashion Magazine 2017. Choose what each model will wear and try different combinations until you're happy with the looks. Style the group so each model has an outfit for the occasion.

pages.title: Steven Universe Coloring Book Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Color Steven and the Crystal Gems in Steven Universe Coloring Book Game. Choose from drawings of Steven, Rose Quartz, Garnet, Pearl, Amethyst, and Connie. Give each picture your own palette, save your finished work, and start another drawing whenever you want to try a new combination.

pages.title: Angela Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Take Angela to the clinic in Angela Skin Doctor and help treat her skin after she returns home. Choose tools for the different problems you find, including pimples, scars, and bugs. Use the laser and the other equipment as you work through her treatment.
